facts.statement: Simblaspis is an extinct genus of arthrodire placoderm fish that lived during the Early Devonian period.
facts.quote: Simblaspis is an extinct monospecific genus of arthrodire placoderm fish of the Early Devonian period.

facts.statement: Simblaspis is considered one of the most basal members of the order Arthrodira and is closely related to the genus Aleosteus.
facts.quote: It is one of the more basal members of the order Arthrodira, closely related to Aleosteus

facts.statement: The type species of Simblaspis was originally described in 1958 from Pragian strata in the Qasr Limestone of Saudi Arabia.
facts.quote: The type species Aleosteus eganensis was described in 1958, and was found in Pragian strata of the Qasr Limestone in Saudi Arabia.

facts.statement: Simblaspis belongs to the family Actinolepididae.
Simblaspis is classified within the class Placodermi.
Simblaspis lived between the Lochkovian and Emsian stages, approximately 419.62 to 393.47 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Lochkovian to Emsian (419.62 to 393.47 million years ago)
